proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free credits daily (refreshed every 24h). FLUX.1-schnell costs ~1 credit per image, SDXL ~0.5 credits.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides stable, fast, direct API access to top-tier models (FLUX.1-schnell, SDXL, ControlNet, IP-Adapter) without requiring complex Hugging Face space configurations or experiencing GitHub Actions IP blocks.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Could be integrated directly into the 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' GitHub Actions pipelines using simple curl requests with an API key.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Daily credits do not roll over; strictly enforced rate limit per minute on the free tier.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous initial $10 free credits on registration. FLUX.1-schnell is priced at $0.003 per image (translates to ~3,330 free images).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Extreme generation speed (<1 second for Schnell) and ultra-reliable developer-first REST API. Perfect for programmatic, bulk image generation in GitHub Actions.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can act as the primary generation engine in 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' or 'produce_tumbler_wraps' when Pollinations quality is insufficient.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires a credit card or GitHub login for verification; once the initial $10 is consumed, it requires transitioning to a pay-as-you-go model.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to list digital STL/3D files. Printables takes a 10% platform fee on sales, with no monthly subscription required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Directly targets the active 3D printing community. Safer and less saturated than Cults3D, with high-intent buyers looking for functional or decorative parametric designs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Ideal distribution channel for the output of 'produce_stl_parametric' scripts.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires designs to be genuinely 3D printable; community is highly technical and quick to flag non-functional or low-quality models.

proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Bypasses search engine scraping blocks, allowing programmatic retrieval of Etsy autocomplete suggestions, Amazon search results, and Google Shopping trends via simple JSON API.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates into 'agent_opportunity_hunter' and 'agent_trend_explosion' to fetch real-time search volume and autocomplete tags to identify niche gaps.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: 100 searches/month is low, meaning scripts must run selectively (e.g., once a week in automated GitHub Cron jobs).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Forever-free plan with unlimited products and storage. 5% transaction fee per sale.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Enables direct digital sales of PDFs, STL files, or game assets with built-in PDF stamping (to prevent piracy) and automatic EU VAT handling (crucial for a French entrepreneur).
proposals.would_integrate_where: Acts as the direct-to-consumer hub for digital assets, linking directly from social media or viral formats without platform lock-in.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires driving own traffic via organic marketing or social media, as it lacks an internal search marketplace like Etsy.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to publish. Platform takes a 30% commission on exclusive listings, or 35% on non-exclusive listings.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The absolute largest marketplace for tabletop RPG assets, custom rulebooks, map packs, and paper-miniatures. Highly targeted audience willing to pay for digital PDFs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Excellent secondary marketplace for 'produce_coloring_book' (re-packaged as fantasy/RPG coloring books) and 'produce_specs_deck'.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict formatting guidelines for PDFs; target audience is highly critical of AI-generated content if not transparently disclosed or highly polished.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free programmatic access via Hugging Face serverless API or public Gradio client wrappers.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: An ultra-lightweight (82M parameters), state-of-the-art text-to-speech model that rivals ElevenLabs in natural voice quality, completely open-source and free.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can be used to generate audio asset packs for game development or voice narration for video books, running directly via Python scripts in GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Public Hugging Face spaces can sometimes go offline or experience high latency under heavy load.
